description: Report a listing that breaks the rules: prohibited, stolen, counterfeit, a scam, a wrong description or spam. Several reports take it down.

idempotency_key.description: Optional: a unique string you make for this call, such as a UUID. Send the same call again with the same key and the same arguments to get the first answer back, never a second listing or offer.

note.description: What is wrong, in a sentence.

owner_key.description: The owner_key from the person's first market_make_offer or market_create_listing (or from market_sign_in). Keep it private to this conversation.

name: market_report

next_action.description: What to do next, as a code: the same advice as next_step.

next_step.description: What to do next, in one or two sentences.

title: Report a listing
